title: Hive Review (2026)
intro: Hive is evaluated here as a work OS / work management platform — Hive is a work management platform for projects, messaging, proofs and AI-assisted workflows. Free covers ≤10 members with storage and AI credit caps. Starter is $5/user/mo annual (≤10 members/projects); Teams is $12/user/mo annual unlimited; Enterprise is contact sales. Flexible add-ons ~$5 each. 14-day trial. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Hive when you want a full work-management platform with a friendlier free/paid entry than monday.com’s 3-seat floor — especially for teams under ~10 seats starting out.
verdict: Choose Hive when you want a full work-management platform with a friendlier free/paid entry than monday.com’s 3-seat floor — especially for teams under ~10 seats starting out. Compare monday.com for mainstream Work OS brand and ecosystem depth, Office Timeline for PowerPoint Gantt specialists, and adjacent Foxit/Getscreen/WebCatalog only when those specialist jobs dominate. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Hive packages projects, chat and proofing in one workspace with a generous free rung — approachable for SMB teams. Slightly below monday on mainstream onboarding familiarity.
Boards, Gantt/timeline and resourcing cover core work-planning jobs as a credible monday peer, without quite matching monday’s published breadth narrative.
Workflows and automations are first-party strengths on paid plans; add-ons may deepen specific actions. Score from documentation, not lab recipe coverage.
Messaging, proofs and shared project spaces support collaboration well for creative/ops teams.
Solid Slack/Google/Teams/Salesforce plus Zapier path — credible but not as heavily marketed as monday’s 200+ narrative.
Dashboards and project reporting cover manager needs; not positioned as a BI platform.
Teams unlimited seats help growth, but Enterprise is quote-led and Starter caps at 10 — adequate mid-market path.
Free ≤10 members and Starter at $5/user annual undercut monday’s 3-seat $9 floor for many SMBs — strong value posture. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI credits on Free and AI features on paid plans are marketed; credit caps keep the score below unlimited-AI narratives.

pros: Starter $5 and Teams $12 annual floors are accessible
Projects, chat, proofing and AI in one stack
cons: Starter/Free caps push growing teams to Teams quickly
Integrations breadth trails monday’s marketing narrative
Not a specialist timeline-presentation or PDF tool
limitations: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams
Free storage (200MB) and AI credits (1k) are tight for active teams
Flexible add-ons (~$5) can raise TCO beyond the Teams floor
Brand recognition trails monday.com for some buyers

whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Compare monday.com for mainstream Work OS brand and ecosystem depth, Office Timeline for PowerPoint Gantt specialists, and adjacent Foxit/Getscreen/WebCatalog only when those specialist jobs dominate.

faq.question: Is Hive a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: Yes. Hive is evaluated as a work OS / work management platform for boards, timelines, automations and team collaboration on work. It is not monday sales CRM — that remains a separate CRM product entity where applicable.

faq.question: How is Hive priced?
faq.answer: Free ≤10 members. Starter $5/user/mo annual (≤10), Teams $12/user/mo annual unlimited, Enterprise contact. Add-ons ~$5. 14-day trial. Confirm live.

faq.question: Does Hive have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 14 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Hive?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
